name: figma-task
description: Sets up a task page in the quarterly Figma file: template copy, Jira widgets, flow boards from prototype screenshots, and a re-checked For dev mapping.

designerEmoji.title: Designer emoji
designerEmoji.description: Your own, in front of every page name — any one no page in the file starts with yet. The mod asks on the first task and saves it here

portalFileKey.title: Portal quarterly Figma file (fileKey)
portalFileKey.description: The current Portal quarter file (named like "Portal 2026 – Q4", in the Figma project "Product task"). Leave empty: the mod asks on the first task and saves it here

ecomFileKey.title: Ecom Figma file (fileKey)
ecomFileKey.description: The current Ecom file (named like "Ecomm (3/26)"). Leave empty: the mod asks on the first Ecom task and saves it here

extraFileKeys.title: Earlier Figma files
extraFileKeys.description: fileKeys of earlier quarterly files, comma-separated — comments and re-uploads keep working there after the quarter changes. set_figma_file adds the replaced file here itself

figmaServer.title: Figma MCP server name
figmaServer.description: The cloud Figma MCP as /mcp lists it

portalRepoPath.title: web-ui-portal-ci checkout
portalRepoPath.description: Leave empty: the mod finds a Portal clone itself (by its git remote, preferring one with node_modules). Set it only to use another clone

webUiShopPath.title: sd/web-ui-shop checkout
webUiShopPath.description: Leave empty: the mod finds a web-ui-shop clone itself (by its git remote). Set it only to use another clone

figmaToken.title: Figma personal access token
figmaToken.description: For /figma-comments: Figma → Settings → Security → Personal access tokens, scopes File comments read + write. Only the mod reads it; the model never sees it

chromiumPath.title: Chromium for Playwright
chromiumPath.description: Optional: an installed chrome-headless-shell, when the repo's Playwright wants another revision
